https://zerokoan.com/about/.body:
Zerokoan Research is a personal archive of security research.
Far be it for me to explain what a Buddhist koan is, but Zerokoan came from an early understanding of what they signify: Abandonment of analytical reason to transcend logic, forcing awareness through intuition over intellect. This is more than likely both an incorrect and glib explanation. Zerokoan is the opposite: Knowing what and why, right now.
Ultimately, it's a doomed endeavor. I'm sure that's obvious, but I was nothing if not obstinate in my youth. I still am, but I was then, too. I'm not sure I can ever leave behind the need to know everything.
Guided by V.A.U.L.T. research methodology principles:
Validated
Actionable
Unflinching
Linked
Transparent

https://zerokoan.com/blog/260417-intenti.body:
If not obvious, this whole thing is very much under construction, with constant change both threatened and delivered.
Most of what I'd worked on previously is just hilariously out of date or just in need of major revision, so I've elected to remove it all and start anew.
Security research focused on helping Blue by imitating Red, before Redactual can do any damage. Breaking is easy; building is so much more difficult.
Currently, overall categories I'm lumping research under:
Red Team
Kind of a catchall for something that's related to Red Team operations. Some things will fall under other, more specific categories as well
Web Assessment
Think GWAPT and OSWA
Network Assessment
GPEN, OSCP
Reconnaissance
OSINT, attack surface mapping, etc
AI
Getting into the grift before I'm adrift
Vulnerabilities
GXPN
Threat Intelligence
APTs, Kill Chains, etc. Not really focused on IOCs, but more the techniques and tooling used

https://zerokoan.com/blog/260430-that-ov.body:
Why Get Paid When You Can Optimize Free Work Efficiency
Going to start working through HackTheBox and OffSec's Proving Grounds boxes to refresh technical knowledge, but also to feel out changes to a couple workflows.
Ultimately, I hope to have:
Obsidian vault with templates to ensure consistency and completeness of notetaking approach
Notes from an assessment within dedicated folder at apex, with screenshots and other supporting evidence somewhere also in the apex
From the notes, a rough skeleton with screenshots and code snippets (potentially using creation timestamps to associate screenshots with related notes and code)
From the rough skeleton, an initial draft of the related writeup
